module.Title: Check the Pickaxe State
module.Teaching: The == operator compares two values. It is different from =, which assigns a value.
module.PredictionExplanation: Use == to compare values without changing them.
module.DebugPrompt: The line assigns true instead of comparing. Replace = with ==.
module.RecallPrompt: Create canMine by comparing hasPickaxe with true.
module.TransferPrompt: Create isEmpty by checking whether stoneCount equals zero. Use the exact value 0.
module.PreviewMessage: Mining permission can now depend on equipment.
